headline: Navigating a foggy terrain

highlights: Q1FY27 margin declined to 4.3%, as steep minimum wage hikes in Haryana and UP coincided with a one-off hit from AIIMS Jammu, prompting management to rule out double-digit margins for the year.
Revenue grew 24% YoY to INR 14.6bn as slow-moving projects gathered pace.
EBITDA margin climbed to 7.6%, partly due to cost pass-throughs taking effect, but stayed well short of the YoY base, pulling PAT down 29% YoY.
Management reiterated its guidance of 15% revenue growth in FY27 and 15–20% in FY28.
valuation: We have also reduced the multiple given the uncertainties, valuing the stock at 14x FY28E earnings (16x FY28E earlier).
Upside risks: 1) Better-than-expected project execution; and 2) better-than-expected profitability.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Some of the key projects, including the Central Vista and CSMT, are expected to see an execution ramp-up through FY27–28.
Uncertainties cloud near-term outlook Ahluwalia has highlighted that construction restrictions in the NCR are expected to impact execution in Q3FY27.
